This private page checks the typography and HTML packaging used by future posts.

## Equations and code

For $x = n + f$, reconstruction uses

$$2^x = 2^n 2^f, \qquad p(t) = a t^2 + b t + c.$$

```cpp
// Horner evaluation uses two multiply-add stages.
int64_t Evaluate(int16_t x, int16_t a, int16_t b, int16_t c) {
  const int64_t first = static_cast<int64_t>(a) * x + b;
  return first * x + c;
}
```

```python
rows = [{"a_bits": 10, "b_bits": 13, "c_bits": 23}]
print(rows[0])
```

| Choice | Lookup | Arithmetic |
|:-------|:-------|:-----------|
| More segments | More coefficient rows | Smaller residual interval |
| Higher degree | More coefficients per row | More Horner stages |

## Local interaction

```{=html}
<div id="preview-widget">
  <label for="preview-x">Input x</label>
  <input id="preview-x" type="range" min="-4" max="0" step="0.25" value="-1">
  <output id="preview-value" for="preview-x">2^-1 = 0.5</output>
</div>
<script>
(() => {
  const widget = document.getElementById('preview-widget');
  const input = widget.querySelector('input');
  const output = widget.querySelector('output');
  input.addEventListener('input', () => {
    output.textContent = `2^${input.value} = ${Math.pow(2, Number(input.value))}`;
  });
})();
</script>
```
